tests.title: matches native NIST SPHERE copy framecrc raw and WAV output across codings byte formats widths channels and rates
matches native NIST SPHERE seek duration and frame-limit timing with copy and decode
matches native NIST SPHERE header text edges and native exit statuses for refused headers
scans NIST SPHERE key lines with sscanf semantics
ports ff_get_line CR LF CRLF and NUL termination and the 255-byte line limit
parses keys in native order with prefix matching and native statuses
opens the data range with bounded reads seeks and explicit refusals
probes NIST_1A with bounded reads and registers a demux-only descriptor
aborts before and between bounded header reads

compares: 336 matrix byte comparisons: copy framecrc, copy raw, -cpuflags 0 decoded WAV and f32le for 84 accepted coding/byte-format/width/channel/rate files
78 timing byte comparisons: -ss/-t/-frames:a profiles, copy and filtered decode, framecrc/WAV/s16le, sample_count exact/absent/mismatched
55 text-edge byte comparisons: CRLF, CR, header_size variants, blank/NUL/254-byte lines, sig_bits, -f nistsphere, metadata keys to framecrc/raw/W64
11 native refusal exit statuses (183, 176, 187) with no output
8 scope refusals also record native's exit status (0, or 234 for a missing rate)

unsupported: bit depths not a multiple of 8 (sig_bits 12), 0-bit, 40-56-bit and 64-bit PCM
metadata keys with WAV/AIFF/AU output (refused; raw, framecrc and W64 accepted)
missing or zero sample_rate or channel_count
header_size past EOF and partial trailing frames
header lines over 255 bytes and headers over 65536 bytes
input -ss when sample_count differs from the physical sample count
detection by .sph/.nist extension without the NIST_1A magic
FLAC input paths, workerd runs, macOS reproduction

proposedContracts.scope: key parsing, codec selection and native statuses

proposedContracts.name: probes NIST_1A with bounded reads and registers a demux-only descriptor

notes: No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
Setup durations: submodule 50 s, npm ci 10 s, reference:build 192 s, baseline static checks 70 s, baseline unit suite 96 s.
Native extra-key metadata is exactly native's sscanf("%31s %*s %31s")==2 test; native WAV output for such files succeeds, EdgeFFmpeg refuses it.
Header scanning is capped at 65536 bytes so headerBytes stays 512 (line buffer plus one read chunk).
